title: Checkout cost versus net cost
hook: A refundable deposit changes checkout cash without changing the modeled net price.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Separate upfront deposits from net cost after a stated full refund.

misconception: Upfront cash paid and net cost after refunds are always the same.
objective: Separate upfront deposits from net cost after a stated full refund.

claims.text: Each item is €2.40 plus a fictional €0.25 deposit, refunded in full on return. Scaled model; fictional deposit; full return assumed.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Containers=4, A=€9.6 and B=€10.6. The geometry pictures follow the declared dimension relationships; other stage pictures are scaled to the larger displayed comparison and icons are not literal item counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["*",2.4,"x"]; B=["*",2.65,"x"]; x denotes Containers. At x=4, A=9.6, B=10.6; recall at x=7: B=18.55. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals.

claims.text: The checkout includes a deposit for each container. The after-return amount subtracts those same deposits. These are different moments in the arithmetic; the scenario does not describe any region’s actual deposit law.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["*",2.4,"x"]; B=["*",2.65,"x"]; x denotes Containers. claims.text: Each item is €2.40 plus a fictional €0.25 deposit, refunded in full on return. Change only Containers to 7. What is B (Checkout) now? Correct: €18.55. Use B's stated rule with Containers=7: it gives €18.55. The checkout includes a deposit for each container. The after-return amount subtracts those same deposits. These are different moments in the arithmetic; the scenario does not describe any region’s actual deposit law.

recall.question: Each item is €2.40 plus a fictional €0.25 deposit, refunded in full on return. Change only Containers to 7. What is B (Checkout) now?
recall.why: Use B's stated rule with Containers=7: it gives €18.55. The checkout includes a deposit for each container. The after-return amount subtracts those same deposits. These are different moments in the arithmetic; the scenario does not describe any region’s actual deposit law.

safety.assumptions: Each item is €2.40 plus a fictional €0.25 deposit, refunded in full on return.
safety.excluded: No chemical mixtures, medical advice, wiring, safety-device bypass, actual tariffs, financial recommendations, temperature, food-storage or food-safety instructions. All energy powers, durations and tariffs are illustrative.
